prompt: Child side of a shell redirect `ls > out.txt`: open the file, make it stdout, close the spare descriptor and run the program. One line does not belong.
lines: int fd = open("out.txt", O_WRONLY | O_CREAT | O_TRUNC, 0644);
explain: `dup2(fd, 1)` makes descriptor 1 refer to the same open file as `fd`; the spare `fd` is then closed, and the redirect survives `exec`. The arguments are `dup2(old, new)`, so `dup2(1, fd)` would do the opposite.
